planned.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Native landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG. ONE full-detail V2 LOCATION KEY, kanghan_guild_hall/key.png: the VAST WHITE TRAINING HALL inside Kanghan's corporate tower at NIGHT. Modern monumental white architecture, polished pale floor, rows of white pillars, tall windows over the night city, and an upper gallery around the room. This is the October 25 rebuilt story's location reference, not a fight or formation scene.

Attached APPROVED Arc 1 V2 references: image 1 is the corporate memorial-hall key, for drawn pale floor, white structural columns and controlled interior line/shadow rendering ONLY; do not copy funeral flowers, portrait, black backdrop, cameras, plants or memorial arrangement. Image 2 is the Kanghan monitoring-room key, for the building's tall dark window framing and the distant city at night ONLY; no monitor wall, green screens, sofas or furniture from it. Image 3 is an approved ADULT front, ONLY an anatomy/proportion comparison for tiny anonymous scale figures; do not draw Jaeha, orange vest, T, notebook, pencil or his identity. Images 4-5 are APPROVED acting HOUSE STYLE anchors for crisp V2 ink and hard opaque cel shadow construction, not their people, gear, rooms or scene lighting. No unapproved L10 office, S17 art, husk formation or other inbox delivery is a reference.

A very large uncluttered rectangular training floor about 35m long and 20m wide, with a 9m-high ceiling. Two orderly rows of substantial plain WHITE structural PILLARS stand along the room's long sides, actually connecting floor and ceiling structure. No classical ornament or temple decorations. Slender dark-framed tall WINDOWS fill much of the picture-right wall and far end; through them a high view of Seoul's NIGHT city lights, not sunset, daylight or a street at the room's own floor height. White wall panels, pale ceiling beams and cool white recessed fixtures form clean, believable connected geometry.

A continuous UPPER GALLERY wraps around the left, far and right sides at about 6m above the training floor. Its walkway has coherent floor thickness and a simple continuous 1.1m-high safety balustrade, with all rails attached and no sudden dead ends. Keep the gallery and the hall's white pillars clearly distinguishable; the gallery is a real walkable level, not an arbitrary belt around the walls. One plain, unlabelled 2.1m door near the far corner anchors human scale; no signs or numbers above it.

The large PALE POLISHED FLOOR clearly reflects pillars, windows and the two scale figures. Reflections are drawn as restrained large planar shapes that align with their actual sources; no duplicated upright people, rippling water, floating pillars or sci-fi floor diagrams. A few straight pale floor joints recede in the same perspective. Leave the broad central training area EMPTY, ready for husks to be added in future chapter panels. NO HUSKS, no mannequins, dolls, armour, summons, monsters, weapons, racks, robots or other performers. In particular do not include the forty-husk formation described in the design text: this entry explicitly draws the EMPTY hall.

Exactly TWO TINY ANONYMOUS ADULTS stand well back near the far-left corner on the actual floor, only about 60-80 pixels tall within this 1024px image. Plain muted charcoal training clothes with no logos or recognizable named-cast identity. Adult 7.5-8-head builds, small heads, full long legs, subtle opposing weight shifts, arms naturally close to their bodies; they are quietly standing, not action posing. Their feet contact the floor and have small aligned reflections. They are ordinary about-1.75m adults compared with the adjacent 2.1m door, 9m pillars and 6m-high gallery. Do not enlarge them into foreground subjects. No extra people on the gallery, in the windows or elsewhere.

Camera about 1.6m above the near training floor, wide eye-level view diagonally down the great room from one end. Near pillar edge may crop at picture-left for depth; see the floor, column bases, undersides of the gallery and the tall ceiling naturally. One consistent horizon/vanishing structure; far adults' eyes lie near that horizon, their feet below it, all architectural planes and reflections agree. No overhead isometric view, contradictory horizons, fisheye distortion, floating feet or miniature adults. Keep full adult proportions even on these tiny figures.

Named key light: COOL WHITE architectural ceiling lights, with faint cold blue NIGHT CITY fill from the tall windows. White and very pale blue-grey base, large cool grey cel shadow planes beneath the gallery and behind pillars, small bright city lights only outside. No Operator-cyan magical glow, orange daylight, red sky, haze, bloom or fantasy energy. The polished floor's sheen is explicitly required by this hall design, but it must still look hand-inked and cel coloured like the approved white-lobby key, not a photoreal or CGI architectural render. No text, labels, letters, numbers, signs, logos, UI, watermark or signature.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
